}}'''Anise syrup''' ({{lang|ar|حبة حلاوة}}, ''habet hlawa'') is an Algerian [[Cookbook:Beverages|drink]]. 

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Anise|anise]] seeds
* 12 [[Cookbook:Deciliter|dl]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]

== Procedure ==
# Pour water into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], add anise seeds, and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium heat.
# Turn off the heat, cover, and leave to infuse for 30 minutes.
# Filter out the seeds.
# Add the sugar as desired, and bring to boil again over medium heat. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] until the [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]] drips into a thin stream.
# Filter a second time.
# Let it cool and bottle. Serve with very cold [[Cookbook:Carbonated Water|sparkling]] or still water according to preference.
